text_markup: During the checkpoint that follows the end of an encounter, abilities that increased the strength of an {subtype:icebreaker} during that encounter expire and the {subtype:icebreaker}'s strength is correspondingly lowered.
text_plain: During the checkpoint that follows the end of an encounter, abilities that increased the strength of an icebreaker during that encounter expire and the icebreaker's strength is correspondingly lowered.
